risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have faults (disc drive, HDMI output, overheating). Photos of a box can’t confirm working condition.
risks.proof: A short video of the PS4 powering on, reaching the home screen, and playing one of the included games (showing the disc/game running).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / untested until a power-on and game-load proof is provided.

risks.risk: Accessories may be incomplete (missing controller, HDMI, power cable, USB cable, etc.).
risks.proof: Clear photo(s) laying out every accessory individually, including controller(s) and all cables, with a count.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete accessories (worst case: missing key items).

risks.risk: Game count may be less than claimed or discs may be scratched/invalid.
risks.proof: Photo of all game discs laid out with the total count visible, plus a quick clip inserting one disc and showing it loads.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as fewer/unknown games (worst case: no usable games).

risks.risk: Region/“Japan” claim may be wrong; some units may have different region behavior or require different handling.
risks.proof: Photo of the console label/serial sticker showing region/model details (or the box label clearly).
risks.if_unproven: Priced without assuming any region advantage.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the console itself (front/back/ports) and the label/serial sticker.
Send a photo/video showing power-on to the PS4 home screen.
Show all accessories laid out (controller(s) and every cable) with a count.
Show all game discs laid out (confirm the number) and a short clip loading one game.
response.reason: From photo 0, the item appears to be a PS4 in a box, but the key details that determine price (working status, completeness of accessories, and the claimed number of games) are not verifiable remotely. Request proof before pricing.
